'''Yu Jihong''' ({{lang-zh|s=于吉红}}; born January 1967) is a Chinese chemist and politician who is a professor at [[Jilin University]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

Yu was a delegate to the [[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]] and serves as a member of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]].

==Biography==
Yu was born in [[Anshan]], [[Liaoning]], in January 1967, while her [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] in [[Feicheng]], [[Shandong]].<ref name="ra">{{cite news |author1=Sun Zhicheng ({{lang|zh|孙志成}})|author2=Gai Yuanyuan ({{lang|zh|盖源源}}) |url=https://finance.sina.com.cn/jjxw/2024-04-30/doc-inatrcht1919905.shtml |script-title=zh:于吉红，出任新职，为副部长级！ |work=sina |date=30 April 2024 |access-date=30 April 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> She earned a bachelor's degree in 1989, a master's degree in 1992, and a doctor's degree in 1995, all in [[chemistry]] and all from [[Jilin University]].<ref name="ra"/> She was a postdoctoral fellow at the [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]] from 1996 to 1997 and [[Tohoku University]] from 1997 to 1998.{{citation needed|date=July 2024}}

Starting 1995, she worked at Jilin University, where she was promoted to associate professor in 1997 and to full professor in 1999.<ref name="ra"/>

On 30 April 2024, she rose to become president of [[Beijing Normal University]], a position at vice-ministerial level.<ref name="ra"/> In October 2022, she was elected as an alternate of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Fu Zhongming ({{lang|zh|符仲明}}) |date=25 September 2022 |title= |script-title=zh:中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会代表名单 |url=http://www.ce.cn/xwzx/gnsz/szyw/202209/25/t20220925_38126370.shtml |access-date=24 October 2022 |work=[[Economic Daily]] |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author1=Xu Kun ({{lang|zh|徐锟}}) |date=22 October 2022 |title= |script-title=zh:中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员名单（171名） |url=http://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202210/22/WS63537f11a310817f312f2d1a.html |access-date=24 October 2022 |work=[[China Daily]] |language=zh}}</ref> In July 2024, the [[3rd plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party|3rd plenary session]] of the 20th Central Committee promoted her as a member of the Central Committee.<ref>{{Cite news |date=18 July 2024 |title=中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第三次全体会议公报 |trans-title=Communiqué of the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party |url=http://www.news.cn/politics/leaders/20240718/a41ada3016874e358d5064bba05eba98/c.html |access-date=18 July 2024 |work=[[Xinhua News Agency]] |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
* November 2016 Fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS)<ref>{{cite news |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2016/11/361132.shtm |script-title=zh:十位内地学者当选发展中国家科学院院士 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=16 November 2016 |access-date=24 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>
* July 2019 Foreign Member of the [[Acadamia Europaea]]<ref>{{cite news |url=http://melab.jlu.edu.cn/info/1176/1852.htm |script-title=zh:吉林大学于吉红教授当选欧洲科学院外籍院士 |work=Jilin University |date=5 July 2019 |access-date=24 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 2021 Foreign Member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]]<ref>{{cite news |url=http://icfs.jlu.edu.cn/info/1347/2070.htm |script-title=zh:吉林大学于吉红教授当选瑞典皇家科学院外籍院士 |work=Jilin University |date=24 September 2021 |access-date=24 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>
